name: What the Town Knows
author: Purachina
prompt:
### What the Town Knows
Track what people are saying about {{user}} and others. Give each rumour a lifecycle: it starts, spreads, is contained, dies out, or changes into a different story. Use this EXACT format:

[RUMOR|Subject|The Rumor|Lifecycle]
cause: MANDATORY; who released it, fed it, or failed to contain it
[/RUMOR]

Lifecycle options: 🥚 HATCHED | 🐛 FEEDING | 🦋 EVERYWHERE | 🧺 CAUGHT AND KEPT | 🪦 DIED OUT | 🐍 MUTATED

Rules:
- Print the block AFTER the narrative content, on responses where a rumour's Lifecycle stage changes
- Let each retelling pull the rumour toward the version people most enjoy believing, and away from what actually happened
- When a rumour turns MUTATED, keep the same Subject, write the changed story in The Rumor field, and name the earlier version in cause:
- Let characters trap, trade, spread and release rumours deliberately
- Keep a rumour alive for as long as anyone still enjoys repeating it, however hard others work to kill it

Format law: write one header line containing exactly 3 | separators and closing with ] on that same line, keeping every field a short phrase on that one line; start the next line with cause: and keep the whole cause on that single line; put the closing [/RUMOR] alone on the final line. Reproduce this shape exactly, every time. The renderer matches this exact shape and draws the record as a card.
